sourceBoundary.mode: Original PreparedSource with an explicit minimal file closure
sourceBoundary.reason: Package export initializers are omitted to avoid unrelated visualization and capability re-exports. The original PreparedSource loader supplies namespace packages; all imported compiler, scheduler, runtime, kernel and dependency modules retain exact source bytes. This oracle covers the specified workflows, not a full-repository application import.

provenance.sourceNameNormalization: Repository-relative display paths; original semantic IR and hashes are preserved.

logos.fact_domain: Finite flat maps of typed JSON scalars. Missing is unknown, never false.
logos.hypothesis_meaning: An empirical transition candidate in one declared scope and exact observed context; not an acquired general causal law.
logos.composition_meaning: A two-contribution candidate with a structural equality raccord. No executable plan or action authorization follows from it.

relational.selection: revalidate a pending member; once test a visible guard boundary; calibrate unknown grounded input; prefer a two-member composition ending at an unvisited projected position; order ties by action identifiers

availability.meaning: Reversible experimental availability, separate from truth or applicability. Observation retention and contradiction maintenance remain active. Source and evidence are not erased.

context_novelty.reason: Prefer an interaction less observed in this exact context; break ties by its declared identifier. No target-specific sequence.

native_context_curiosity.reason: Examiner d'abord une interaction moins observée dans le contexte exact actuel, puis dans cette portée ; départager par identifiant.

experiment_policy.reason: Choisir une interaction dont les effets restent à examiner, parmi les commandes entièrement liées ; préférer le moins d'essais observés dans cette portée, puis départager par identifiant. Ce départage ne prouve aucune supériorité causale.

constraints.unpredicted: orthogonal displacement, hidden state and outside-view continuation

body.meaning: Rebind relative origins; join the first projected effect to the second precondition; independently revalidate each material guard.

body.intent: What changes, and what remains unexplained, after this interaction?

rationale.curiosity: Open interaction questions without a supplied goal or expected outcome. Exact context/action identity deduplicates them; an observed result still needs explanation.
rationale.acquisition: Retain measured transitions as exact-context hypotheses. A changed full observation signature does not establish an invariant causal mechanism.
rationale.refutation: In the same declared scope, complete measured context and action, a different complete outcome contradicts the empirical hypothesis. Preserve both outcomes.
rationale.composition: A nonempty equality intersection between declared effects and conditions can propose a pair, but never discharges all applicability obligations.
rationale.revision: Suspend compositions whose direct hypothesis dependencies are contradicted. This prototype emits only pairs, so no deeper closure is claimed.

sources.generators:
MODULE prototype.v7

WORKFLOW cycle(request: Any, interactions: List<String>) -> Any
    STATE
        memory: Any
        with_after: Any
        with_before: Any
        revised: Any
        revised_question: Any
        revised_composition: Any
        before_ref: Any
        after_ref: Any
        transition_ref: Any
        item_ref: Any
        hypotheses: List<Any>
        transitions: List<Any>
        compositions: List<Any>
        questions: List<Any>
        effects: Any
        raccord: Any
        scope_matches: Any
        context_matches: Any
        action_matches: Any
        outcome_matches: Any
        question_scope_matches: Any
        question_context_matches: Any
        question_action_matches: Any
        contradicted: Any
        first_candidate: Any
        second_candidate: Any
        distinct_members: Any
        same_scope: Any
        has_raccord: Any
        fresh: Any
        member: Any
        candidate: Any
        composition_disabled: Boolean
    STEP begin
        CALL v7.value(value=request.memory) -> memory
        NEXT observations
    STEP observations
        CALL v7.emit(memory=memory, template="observation", bindings=[["observation", request.after]]) -> with_after
        CALL v7.identity(template="observation", bindings=[["observation", request.after]]) -> after_ref
        IF request.has_transition
            CALL v7.emit(memory=with_after, template="observation", bindings=[["observation", request.before]]) -> with_before
            CALL v7.identity(template="observation", bindings=[["observation", request.before]]) -> before_ref
            CALL v7.difference(before=request.before.values, after=request.after.values) -> effects
            CALL v7.identity(template="transition", bindings=[["before", request.before], ["action", request.action], ["after", request.after]]) -> transition_ref
            CALL v7.absent(memory=with_before, identity=transition_ref) -> fresh
            IF fresh
                CALL v7.emit(memory=with_before, template="transition", bindings=[["before", request.before], ["after", request.after], ["action", request.action], ["effects", effects], ["before_ref", before_ref], ["after_ref", after_ref]]) -> memory
                NEXT construct
            ELSE
                CALL v7.value(value=with_before) -> memory
                NEXT availability
        ELSE
            CALL v7.value(value=with_after) -> memory
            NEXT availability
    STEP construct
        CALL v7.emit(memory=memory, template="hypothesis", bindings=[["before", request.before], ["after", request.after], ["action", request.action], ["effects", effects], ["transition_ref", transition_ref]]) -> memory
        NEXT acquisition
    STEP acquisition
        CALL v7.select(memory=memory, kind="hypothesis") -> hypotheses
        CALL v7.select(memory=memory, kind="transition") -> transitions
        FOR EACH hypothesis IN hypotheses
            FOR EACH transition IN transitions
                CALL v7.equal(left=hypothesis.scope, right=transition.scope) -> scope_matches
                IF scope_matches
                    CALL v7.equal(left=hypothesis.context, right=transition.context) -> context_matches
                    IF context_matches
                        CALL v7.equal(left=hypothesis.action, right=transition.action) -> action_matches
                        IF action_matches
                            CALL v7.equal(left=hypothesis.prediction, right=transition.outcome) -> outcome_matches
                            IF outcome_matches
                                CALL v7.append_unique(memory=memory, identity=hypothesis.id, field="evidence", value=transition.id) -> memory
                            ELSE
                                CALL v7.assign(memory=memory, identity=hypothesis.id, field="status", value="contradicted") -> revised
                                CALL v7.append_unique(memory=revised, identity=hypothesis.id, field="counterexamples", value=transition.id) -> memory
        CALL v7.select(memory=memory, kind="question") -> questions
        FOR EACH question IN questions
            CALL v7.equal(left=question.scope, right=request.before.scope) -> question_scope_matches
            IF question_scope_matches
                CALL v7.equal(left=question.context, right=request.before.values) -> question_context_matches
                IF question_context_matches
                    CALL v7.equal(left=question.action, right=request.action) -> question_action_matches
                    IF question_action_matches
                        CALL v7.assign(memory=memory, identity=question.id, field="status", value="effect_to_explain") -> revised_question
                        CALL v7.append_unique(memory=revised_question, identity=question.id, field="evidence", value=transition_ref) -> memory
        NEXT revision
    STEP revision
        CALL v7.select(memory=memory, kind="composition") -> compositions
        CALL v7.select(memory=memory, kind="hypothesis") -> hypotheses
        FOR EACH composition IN compositions
            FOR EACH hypothesis IN hypotheses
                CALL v7.contains(items=composition.members, value=hypothesis.id) -> member
                IF member
                    CALL v7.equal(left=hypothesis.status, right="contradicted") -> contradicted
                    IF contradicted
                        CALL v7.assign(memory=memory, identity=composition.id, field="status", value="suspended") -> revised_composition
                        CALL v7.append_unique(memory=revised_composition, identity=composition.id, field="counterexamples", value=hypothesis.id) -> memory
        NEXT availability
    STEP availability
        CALL v7.contains(items=request.availability.selection.disabled_kinds, value="composition") -> composition_disabled
        IF composition_disabled
            NEXT curiosity
        ELSE
            NEXT composition
    STEP composition
        CALL v7.select_active(memory=memory, kind="hypothesis", selection=request.availability.selection, dependency_fields=request.availability.dependency_fields) -> hypotheses
        FOR EACH first IN hypotheses
            CALL v7.equal(left=first.status, right="candidate") -> first_candidate
            IF first_candidate
                FOR EACH second IN hypotheses
                    CALL v7.equal(left=second.status, right="candidate") -> second_candidate
                    IF second_candidate
                        CALL v7.distinct(left=first.id, right=second.id) -> distinct_members
                        IF distinct_members
                            CALL v7.equal(left=first.scope, right=second.scope) -> same_scope
                            IF same_scope
                                CALL v7.intersection(left=first.effects, right=second.conditions) -> raccord
                                CALL v7.nonempty(items=raccord) -> has_raccord
                                IF has_raccord
                                    CALL v7.emit(memory=memory, template="composition", bindings=[["first", first], ["second", second], ["raccord", raccord]]) -> memory
        NEXT curiosity
    STEP curiosity
        FOR EACH action IN interactions
            CALL v7.emit(memory=memory, template="question", bindings=[["observation", request.after], ["action", action], ["observation_ref", after_ref]]) -> memory
        STOP memory
sources.activation:
MODULE prototype.v7_activation

WORKFLOW configure(request: Any) -> Any
    STATE
        created: Any
        identity: Any
        memory: Any
    STEP configure
        CALL v7.identity(template="activation", bindings=[]) -> identity
        CALL v7.emit(memory=request.memory, template="activation", bindings=[["configuration", request.configuration]]) -> created
        CALL v7.assign(memory=created, identity=identity, field="configuration", value=request.configuration) -> memory
        STOP memory
sources.experiment:
MODULE prototype.v7_experiment

WORKFLOW choose(request: Any) -> Any
    STATE
        memory: Any
        questions: List<Any>
        transitions: List<Any>
        scope_matches: Boolean
        context_matches: Boolean
        question_eligible: Boolean
        binding: Any
        trials: Any
        context_trials: Any
        option: Any
        found: Boolean
        replace: Boolean
        best_question: Any
        best_binding: Any
        best_trials: Any
        best_option: Any
        rank_key: Any
        best_rank: Any
        experiment_disabled: Boolean
        options_disabled: Boolean
    STEP availability
        CALL v7.value(value=request.memory) -> memory
        CALL v7.contains(items=request.availability.selection.disabled_kinds, value="experiment") -> experiment_disabled
        IF experiment_disabled
            STOP memory
        ELSE
            NEXT option_availability
    STEP option_availability
        CALL v7.contains(items=request.availability.selection.disabled_kinds, value="experiment_option") -> options_disabled
        IF options_disabled
            STOP memory
        ELSE
            NEXT begin
    STEP begin
        CALL v7.value(value=request.memory) -> memory
        CALL v7.value(value=false) -> found
        CALL v7.select_active(memory=memory, kind="question", selection=request.availability.selection, dependency_fields=request.availability.dependency_fields) -> questions
        CALL v7.select_active(memory=memory, kind="transition", selection=request.availability.selection, dependency_fields=request.availability.dependency_fields) -> transitions
        NEXT rank
    STEP rank
        FOR EACH question IN questions
            CALL v7.equal(left=question.scope, right=request.observation.scope) -> scope_matches
            IF scope_matches
                CALL v7.equal(left=question.context, right=request.observation.values) -> context_matches
                IF context_matches
                    CALL v7.contains(items=request.policy.eligible_question_statuses, value=question.status) -> question_eligible
                    IF question_eligible
                        CALL v7.get(mapping=request.bindings, key=question.action) -> binding
                        CALL v7.count_matching(items=transitions, selectors=[["scope", question.scope], ["action", question.action]]) -> trials
                        CALL v7.count_matching(items=transitions, selectors=[["scope", question.scope], ["action", question.action], ["context", question.context]]) -> context_trials
                        CALL v7.identity(template="experiment_option", bindings=[["observation", request.observation], ["question", question], ["basis", request.basis]]) -> option
                        IF binding.grounded
                            CALL v7.emit(memory=memory, template="experiment_option", bindings=[["observation", request.observation], ["question", question], ["basis", request.basis], ["status", "eligible"], ["trials", trials], ["grounding", binding.reason], ["observation_node", request.observation_node]]) -> memory
                            CALL v7.substitute(pattern=request.policy.order, bindings=[["context_trials", context_trials], ["trials", trials], ["action", question.action]]) -> rank_key
                            IF found
                                CALL v7.less(left=rank_key, right=best_rank) -> replace
                            ELSE
                                CALL v7.value(value=true) -> replace
                            IF replace
                                CALL v7.value(value=question) -> best_question
                                CALL v7.value(value=binding) -> best_binding
                                CALL v7.value(value=trials) -> best_trials
                                CALL v7.value(value=option) -> best_option
                                CALL v7.value(value=rank_key) -> best_rank
                                CALL v7.value(value=true) -> found
                        ELSE
                            CALL v7.emit(memory=memory, template="experiment_option", bindings=[["observation", request.observation], ["question", question], ["basis", request.basis], ["status", "deferred"], ["trials", trials], ["grounding", binding.reason], ["observation_node", request.observation_node]]) -> memory
        NEXT propose
    STEP propose
        IF found
            CALL v7.emit(memory=memory, template="experiment", bindings=[["observation", request.observation], ["question", best_question], ["option", best_option], ["binding", best_binding], ["trials", best_trials], ["policy", request.policy], ["basis", request.basis], ["observation_node", request.observation_node]]) -> memory
        STOP memory
